item.title: Weekly Threat Summary — 2026-09-12 — Cyber Threat Wall Weekly intelligence brief
item.description: Threat Signal —. CISA added 14 actively exploited vulnerabilities during the last 7 days. Other is the most represented technology category among this week's new KEVs (5). MikroTik has the most new KEV entries this week (2). CVE-2022-41352 is the largest 7-day rank riser, up 608 positions.
